entities.name: Hannah Roberts
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hannah Roberts is an American BMX freestyle cyclist. She is a five-time world champion in the UCI Urban Cycling World Championships and silver medalist in freestyle BMX at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.
